open_findings.minimal_repair: In the three allowed files only: (1) in source-flip test 2 and in consumer-parity's postgresWithoutVault (or one consumer test), add an in-suite control that, with the probe path active, sets ASCEND_PROSPECT_SOURCE='vault' for one read and asserts that prospect discovery returns 0 (e.g. listProspects() is empty and the knowledge-index prospect registry is empty), while the Postgres-mode read under the same probe still equals the baseline. Restore the source setting in finally. (2) Commit with a message body recording the focused controlled run of the three suites: exact per-suite passed/failed/skipped counts, the control result, confirmation that no tracked file changed (git status empty), and the read-only applogin/scratch-schema cleanup check. No URLs, values or secrets. Then freeze r2.
open_findings.observed: The current-source proof now rests entirely on the empty-vault probe: in source-flip test 2 (slugs listed with the vault path emptied equal a baseline read) and in consumer-parity's postgresWithoutVault (each consumer's output with only '02 - Sales & Hit List' emptied equals the current output). No code in these files, and no published evidence (one-line commit message; the manifest records only typecheck; no report on disk), shows that the probe catches the defect it exists for: a consumer still discovering prospects from the vault. If the probe did not actually remove vault prospect discovery (a wrong directory name, a symlinked prospect dir, or a reader that ignores ASCEND_VAULT_PATH), every comparison would pass vacuously. CURRENT-SOURCE-AND-CONTROLS requires demonstrating at least one control going red for the intended defect, and FOCUSED-CONTROLLED-PROOF requires exact focused results and a post-run clean tree. Neither can be verified from the published object.

regression_proof.description: The new in-suite control passes in the focused controlled run, and would fail if the probe left vault prospect discovery intact. The r2 commit body records the three suites' exact counts and a clean post-run tree.
